notes: The residual vector is the fixture, deliberately. Deriving it from a point cloud would let a disagreement be a difference in how two programs interpolated a surface rather than a difference between the estimators under test.
Four of the six cases carry closed forms, and both sides are scored against those before they are compared to each other.
The tolerance and the reference output landed in the same commit, so the freeze is recorded as adopted-with-result rather than as a preregistration.

reference.containerPinningNote: No container was pulled for this reference. The script is base R only, so the reference surface is the R build itself, and the resolved executable path, the version string R reported and the exact command line stand in for a digest.

datasets.description: Six residual vectors written as exact decimal literals: a symmetric five-value set, a constant offset, bias plus spread, a single gross outlier among nineteen zeros, a hundred asymmetric values from an explicit rule, and ten values where the 95th percentile falls between samples. Four carry values computed from the construction.

parameterSets.description: The pooled bias, RMSE and maximum absolute residual over each fixture case, with minSample 1 so every case reports. Residual is measured minus reference, so each fixture value enters as a measurement against a zero reference. Three quantities across six cases give eighteen comparisons.

statusReason: All eighteen comparisons across the six cases are within the registered 1e-12, the largest difference being 4.44e-16. The registered parameter set is deliberately the convention-free half of the module output. Median, NMAD and P95 are excluded because they are not comparable without naming a quantile convention: R interpolates at type 7, the candidate takes the nearest rank, and on the ten-value case the two medians are 5.5 and 5. Compared against R computed under the candidate own nearest-rank convention the P95 agrees everywhere, which places that gap in the definition and not in the arithmetic. Nothing was widened.

unsupported: Median, NMAD and P95 as reported by the module, which depend on a quantile convention the two implementations do not share. The difference is recorded and not resolved here.
How a residual vector is produced. The comparison starts at the residuals, so interpolation, ground classification and gridding are all outside it.
Checkpoint independence. The fixtures are residual vectors, and nothing about where they came from is modelled.
Real terrain and real returns. Every fixture value is an exact decimal literal.
Accuracy against ground truth. Agreement with R is agreement on arithmetic.
